title: Node add_peer silently overwrites a different key on IID collision
description: Security review of python/src/lichen/node.py found add_peer assigns peer_db[canonical.iid] unconditionally. A different public key with the same 64-bit derived IID can replace an out-of-band or previously announced identity before link pinning, or make the existing peer unverifiable after pinning, turning an IID collision into trust substitution or persistent denial of service. Detect distinct-key collisions atomically, preserve the incumbent binding, surface a key-change/collision event, and add pre-pin and post-pin collision regressions using controlled PeerIdentity fixtures.
